data.name: Brett Leatherman
positions: Assistant Director, FBI Cyber Division (from June 2025)
Deputy Assistant Director, FBI Cyber Division, Cyber Operations Branch (documented February 2024)
public_roles: Head of the FBI Cyber Division
Host of the FBI Ahead of the Threat podcast, season two
misc: Kash Patel selected or elevated Leatherman to lead the Cyber Division in June 2025.
FBI materials show Leatherman implementing President Trump's Cyber Strategy for America.
A verified institutional WEF path exists through FBI membership and FBI Cyber Division participation in WEF's Partnership against Cybercrime.
No official source reviewed names Leatherman personally as a WEF member, contributor, adviser or attendee.
Lacroix v. Leatherman is retained only as a disputed, unverified litigation lead.
The reviewed court opinions do not identify misconduct by Leatherman.

inferences: The Trump link is institutional and operational, not proof of personal political affiliation.
caveats: FBI organizational membership in a WEF initiative is not personal membership by every FBI official.
A complaint is not a finding of liability or corruption.
gaps: PACER-level review of Lacroix v. Leatherman.
